summary: UnicalAdmission is the University of Calabria's early admission selection for non-EU students living abroad. For 2026/27 it awarded 132 scholarships to foreign master's students, covering tuition, free board and lodging and a €3,600 allowance. The university expects to publish the 2027/28 call in January 2027.

how_to_apply: Wait for the 2027/28 call, which the university expects to publish on its UnicalAdmission page in January 2027.
Register on the university's ESSE3 portal and follow the call's steps. Questions go to unicaladmission@unical.it.
